newsitem.title: GERMANY: German Oct/July sugar sales higher at 2.31 mln T.
newsitem.headline: German Oct/July sugar sales higher at 2.31 mln T.

text.p: German sugar sales in the first ten months of the 1995/96 (October/September) season were 2.31 million tonnes, up from 2.26 million in October/July 1994/95, data from the sugar industry association WVZ showed.
The figures were rounded, whites value.
Sugar sales in July of 264,763 tonnes compared with 236,909 in June 1996 and 247,064 in July 1995.
Stocks at the end of July totalled 806,767 tonnes versus 814,425 a year earlier.
Carry-in stocks on October 1, 1995 had been 250,854 tonnes (versus 470,689 a year earlier).
July imports of 10,759 tonnes were slightly higher than 10,618 year earlier, while exports of 63,804 tonnes compared with 105,554 in July 1995.
Domestic sugar production in Oct/July 95/96 of 3.82 million tonnes compared with 3.67 million a year earlier.
